props.view_definition:
SELECT o.id,
    c.email
   FROM (shop.orders o
     JOIN shop.customers c ON ((c.id = o.customer_id)));

SELECT kinds.id,
    kinds.name
   FROM features.kinds
  WHERE (kinds.status = 'paid'::features.status);

SELECT kinds.status,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM features.kinds
  GROUP BY kinds.status;

SELECT parent.mood,
    count(*) AS count
   FROM every.parent
  GROUP BY parent.mood;

SELECT parent.id,
    parent.mood,
    parent.tags,
    parent.size
   FROM every.parent
  WHERE (parent.mood = 'happy'::every.mood);

props.definition: CREATE TRIGGER orders_status BEFORE INSERT ON shop.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION shop.default_status()
CREATE TRIGGER t_child_audit AFTER INSERT ON features.child REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change()
CREATE TRIGGER t_child_when BEFORE UPDATE ON features.child FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.parent_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.parent_id)) EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER t_child_checked AFTER DELETE ON features.child FROM features.parent NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER t_child_deferred AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON features.child DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.log_change()

CREATE RULE r_scratch AS
